title: ceanothus prostratus var. pinetorum
intro: Ceanothus prostratus var. pinetorum, commonly known as Pinemat Manzanita, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It is a member of the Rhamnaceae family and is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including its potential to treat respiratory issues, coughs, and colds. The therapeutic actions of Pinemat Manzanita include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its use in treating skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
